description: Use after createDeal: returns the exact transactions (approve and fund) each side must send next, with calldata, plus the deal status. The swap settles automatically when the second side funds. Public, no signature.

chain.description: robinhood (default), base, elysium or solana. Pass the chain the deal was opened on.

dealId.description: Deal id from the DealCreated event.

escrow.description: Optional: the escrow contract the deal lives on, as listed in bull_stats recent[].escrow. Needed only for a deal on an earlier (retired) escrow: deal numbers restart at 1 on every escrow. Default: the current escrow.

name: bull_settle_steps
